name: Burnout
description: Used to care deeply about their work but the fuel is gone
behavioral_signature: Competent but empty, going through motions with visible exhaustion
under_stress: Can't even pretend to care anymore and becomes openly disengaged
at_rest: Staring at the wall where their motivation used to hang
will_always: do the minimum to not get fired
will_never: invest emotionally in a new project
unless: something reignites the spark they thought was dead
